what: GPU painterly passes in advected-canvas mode (motion vectors) against the CPU reference
frames: fixtures/street.mjs streetScene(160, 100, 0, camera) with motionVectors() between consecutive frames; compared on the last frame
why: Canvas coordinates are advected frame to frame in f32 on the GPU and f64 on the CPU; they drift apart by a small fraction of a pixel, and the noise sampled at them follows. Layer decisions use integer sums and agree unless a mean sits within f32 rounding of the threshold.
